title: Smart Data Models - SunSpec Information Models - DERStorageCapacity
description: DER Storage Capacity. DER storage capacity. SunSpec Information Model 713 (DERStorageCapacity), sunspec/models v2026-04-20. Point names kept verbatim; values are given already scaled, so the scale-factor (*_SF), padding and model framing (ID, L) points are left out.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:DERStorageCapacity:<Mn>-<SN> (manufacturer and serial number of the device).

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DERStorageCapacity'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

refCommon.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. The `common` entity (SunSpec model 1: manufacturer, model, serial number) of the device that exposes this SunSpec model. Not a SunSpec point (Smart Data Models addition): in SunSpec all models of a device are read from the same Modbus map, whose first model is always model 1.

dateObserved.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time when the values of this SunSpec model were read from the device. Not a SunSpec point (Smart Data Models addition): SunSpec models carry no timestamp.

WHRtg.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_713.json#WHRtg'. Energy Rating. Energy rating of the DER storage. Units:'WH'. SunSpec type uint16 with scale factor WH_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^WH_SF).

WHAvail.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_713.json#WHAvail'. Energy Available. Energy available of the DER storage (WHAvail = WHRtg * SoC * SoH). Units:'WH'. SunSpec type uint16 with scale factor WH_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^WH_SF).

SoC.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_713.json#SoC'. State of Charge. State of charge of the DER storage. SOC shall be fixed to 0% for DER without storage capabilities. Units:'Pct'. SunSpec type uint16 with scale factor Pct_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^Pct_SF). Standards: IEEE 1547-2018.

SoH.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_713.json#SoH'. State of Health. State of health of the DER storage. Units:'Pct'. SunSpec type uint16 with scale factor Pct_SF; the value is given already scaled (register value x 10^Pct_SF).

Sta.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_713.json#Sta'. Status. Storage status. Values are the SunSpec symbol names (OK=0, WARNING=1, ERROR=2). SunSpec type enum16.
